question: 各物料锁定库存占在库库存的比例
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, SUM(i.locked_qty) AS locked_qty, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS on_hand_qty, ROUND(SUM(i.locked_qty) * 1.0 / SUM(i.on_hand_qty), 4) AS locked_share FROM inventory i JOIN material m ON m.material_id = i.material_id GROUP BY m.material_id, m.material_name ORDER BY locked_share DESC, m.material_id

question: 各仓库的库存金额与可用库存数量汇总
gold_sql: SELECT i.warehouse, ROUND(SUM(i.on_hand_qty * m.standard_cost), 2) AS inventory_value, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty FROM inventory i JOIN material m ON m.material_id = i.material_id GROUP BY i.warehouse ORDER BY inventory_value DESC

question: 在途采购金额（按标准成本估算）是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(po.qty * m.standard_cost), 2) AS in_transit_value FROM purchase_order po JOIN material m ON m.material_id = po.material_id WHERE po.status = 'in_transit'

question: 各物料的在途采购数量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_name, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty FROM purchase_order po JOIN material m ON m.material_id = po.material_id WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY m.material_name ORDER BY in_transit_qty DESC, m.material_name

question: 各供应商的在途采购单数量统计
gold_sql: SELECT po.supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS po_count, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.supplier_name ORDER BY po_count DESC, po.supplier_name

question: 2026年8月及以后预计到货的在途采购单有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT po.po_id, po.material_id, po.supplier_name, po.qty, po.expected_date FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' AND po.expected_date >= '2026-08-01' ORDER BY po.expected_date, po.po_id

question: 已到货的采购单对应的物料及数量
gold_sql: SELECT po.po_id, m.material_name, po.qty, po.expected_date FROM purchase_order po JOIN material m ON m.material_id = po.material_id WHERE po.status = 'received' ORDER BY po.expected_date, po.po_id

question: 各供应商在途采购金额的占比
gold_sql: SELECT po.supplier_name, ROUND(SUM(po.qty * m.standard_cost) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(p2.qty * m2.standard_cost) FROM purchase_order p2 JOIN material m2 ON m2.material_id = p2.material_id WHERE p2.status = 'in_transit'), 4) AS value_share FROM purchase_order po JOIN material m ON m.material_id = po.material_id WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.supplier_name ORDER BY value_share DESC, po.supplier_name

question: 各状态工单的数量是多少？

question: 每张订单的工单计划数量与完工数量汇总

question: 在制工单（in_progress）的完工率明细

question: 整机设备（FG001）BOM逐层展开的物料清单及层级
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(parent_id, child_id, qty, level) AS (SELECT b.parent_material_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.parent_material_id = 'FG001' UNION ALL SELECT bt.child_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bom_tree bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.child_id) SELECT bt.level, bt.child_id AS material_id, m.material_name, bt.qty FROM bom_tree bt JOIN material m ON m.material_id = bt.child_id ORDER BY bt.level, bt.child_id

question: 精密导轨（M003）BOM展开后各子件的累计用量
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(parent_id, child_id, total_qty, level) AS (SELECT b.parent_material_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.parent_material_id = 'M003' UNION ALL SELECT bt.child_id, b.child_material_id, bt.total_qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bom_tree bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.child_id) SELECT bt.child_id AS material_id, m.material_name, ROUND(SUM(bt.total_qty), 4) AS total_qty, MIN(bt.level) AS first_level FROM bom_tree bt JOIN material m ON m.material_id = bt.child_id GROUP BY bt.child_id, m.material_name ORDER BY first_level, bt.child_id

question: 各父项物料的BOM子件数量统计

question: 订单ORD-1001的物料齐套率是多少？
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bt(root_id, parent_id, qty, level) AS (SELECT oi.material_id, oi.material_id, oi.qty, 0 FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1001' UNION ALL SELECT bt.root_id, b.child_material_id, bt.qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.parent_id), req AS (SELECT material_id, SUM(qty) AS required_qty FROM (SELECT oi.material_id, oi.qty FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1001' AND oi.material_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT parent_material_id FROM bom) UNION ALL SELECT bt.parent_id AS material_id, bt.qty FROM bt WHERE bt.level > 0) GROUP BY material_id), sup AS (SELECT m.material_id, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) FROM inventory i WHERE i.material_id = m.material_id), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(po.qty) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.material_id = m.material_id AND po.status = 'in_transit'), 0) AS supply_qty FROM material m) SELECT r.material_id, m.material_name, r.required_qty, s.supply_qty, ROUND(MIN(1.0, s.supply_qty * 1.0 / r.required_qty), 4) AS fill_rate FROM req r JOIN material m ON m.material_id = r.material_id JOIN sup s ON s.material_id = r.material_id ORDER BY fill_rate ASC, r.material_id

gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, COALESCE(d.demand_qty, 0) AS demand_qty, COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0) AS available_qty, COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) AS in_transit_qty, COALESCE(d.demand_qty, 0) - COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0) - COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) AS net_gap FROM material m LEFT JOIN (SELECT oi.material_id, SUM(oi.qty) AS demand_qty FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY oi.material_id) d ON d.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.material_id) a ON a.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT po.material_id, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.material_id) t ON t.material_id = m.material_id WHERE COALESCE(d.demand_qty, 0) - COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0) - COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) > 0 ORDER BY net_gap DESC, m.material_id

question: 未发货订单各物料的供给覆盖率（可用库存加在途采购除以需求数量）
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, d.demand_qty, COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0) + COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) AS supply_qty, ROUND((COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0) + COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0)) * 1.0 / d.demand_qty, 4) AS cover_ratio FROM material m JOIN (SELECT oi.material_id, SUM(oi.qty) AS demand_qty FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY oi.material_id) d ON d.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.material_id) a ON a.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT po.material_id, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.material_id) t ON t.material_id = m.material_id ORDER BY cover_ratio ASC, m.material_id

question: 各地区待发货订单的物料需求总量与其可用库存总量的比值
gold_sql: WITH demand AS (SELECT o.region, oi.material_id, SUM(oi.qty) AS demand_qty FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY o.region, oi.material_id), supply AS (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.material_id) SELECT d.region, SUM(d.demand_qty) AS demand_qty, SUM(s.available_qty) AS available_qty, ROUND(SUM(d.demand_qty) * 1.0 / SUM(s.available_qty), 4) AS demand_supply_ratio FROM demand d JOIN supply s ON s.material_id = d.material_id GROUP BY d.region ORDER BY demand_supply_ratio DESC

question: 各客户待发货订单金额占其全部订单金额的比例
gold_sql: WITH all_amount AS (SELECT o.customer_name, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_name), pending_amount AS (SELECT o.customer_name, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS pending_value FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY o.customer_name) SELECT a.customer_name, ROUND(p.pending_value, 2) AS pending_value, ROUND(p.pending_value * 1.0 / a.total_amount, 4) AS pending_share FROM all_amount a JOIN pending_amount p ON p.customer_name = a.customer_name ORDER BY pending_share DESC, a.customer_name

question: 各销售代表的逾期订单金额占比
gold_sql: WITH rep AS (SELECT o.sales_rep, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'pending' AND o.due_date < '2026-07-01' THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.sales_rep) SELECT sales_rep, ROUND(total_amount, 2) AS total_amount, ROUND(overdue_amount, 2) AS overdue_amount, ROUND(overdue_amount * 1.0 / total_amount, 4) AS overdue_share FROM rep ORDER BY overdue_share DESC, sales_rep

question: 可用库存低于安全库存的物料在未发货订单上还需要多少数量？
gold_sql: WITH avail AS (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty, MAX(m.safety_stock) AS safety_stock FROM inventory i JOIN material m ON m.material_id = i.material_id GROUP BY i.material_id), dem AS (SELECT oi.material_id, SUM(oi.qty) AS pending_qty FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY oi.material_id) SELECT a.material_id, m.material_name, a.available_qty, a.safety_stock, d.pending_qty FROM avail a JOIN material m ON m.material_id = a.material_id JOIN dem d ON d.material_id = a.material_id WHERE a.available_qty < a.safety_stock ORDER BY d.pending_qty DESC, a.material_id

question: 可用库存低于安全库存的物料，在途采购到货后能否补足安全库存？
gold_sql: WITH avail AS (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.material_id), transit AS (SELECT po.material_id, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.material_id) SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, a.available_qty, COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) AS in_transit_qty, m.safety_stock, CASE WHEN a.available_qty + COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) >= m.safety_stock THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS covered_after_arrival FROM avail a JOIN material m ON m.material_id = a.material_id LEFT JOIN transit t ON t.material_id = a.material_id WHERE a.available_qty < m.safety_stock ORDER BY covered_after_arrival, m.material_id

question: 各销售物料累计销量与当前可用库存的比值
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, SUM(oi.qty) AS sold_qty, a.available_qty, ROUND(SUM(oi.qty) * 1.0 / a.available_qty, 4) AS sales_stock_ratio FROM order_item oi JOIN material m ON m.material_id = oi.material_id JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.material_id) a ON a.material_id = m.material_id GROUP BY m.material_id, m.material_name, a.available_qty ORDER BY sales_stock_ratio DESC, m.material_id

question: 在途采购涉及的供应商、物料及其当前可用库存对照
gold_sql: SELECT po.supplier_name, m.material_id, m.material_name, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty, (SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) FROM inventory i WHERE i.material_id = m.material_id) AS available_qty FROM purchase_order po JOIN material m ON m.material_id = po.material_id WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.supplier_name, m.material_id, m.material_name ORDER BY in_transit_qty DESC, po.supplier_name

question: 每张订单的订购数量与已发货数量差异明细
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_name, o.status, (SELECT SUM(oi.qty) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AS ordered_qty, (SELECT SUM(sh.shipped_qty) FROM shipment sh WHERE sh.order_id = o.order_id) AS shipped_qty, (SELECT SUM(oi.qty) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sh.shipped_qty) FROM shipment sh WHERE sh.order_id = o.order_id), 0) AS open_qty FROM sales_order o ORDER BY open_qty DESC, o.order_id

question: 2026年6月销售金额相对5月的环比增长率是多少？
gold_sql: WITH mo AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7)) SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-06' THEN amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-05' THEN amount END)) * 1.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-05' THEN amount END), 4) AS growth_rate FROM mo

question: 整机设备（FG001）的单台BOM标准成本与最高销售单价对比
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(parent_id, child_id, total_qty, level) AS (SELECT b.parent_material_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.parent_material_id = 'FG001' UNION ALL SELECT bt.child_id, b.child_material_id, bt.total_qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bom_tree bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.child_id), roll AS (SELECT child_id AS material_id, SUM(total_qty) AS total_qty FROM bom_tree GROUP BY child_id), cost AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.total_qty * m.standard_cost), 2) AS bom_cost FROM roll r JOIN material m ON m.material_id = r.material_id) SELECT cost.bom_cost, (SELECT MAX(oi.unit_price) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.material_id = 'FG001') AS sale_unit_price, ROUND((SELECT MAX(oi.unit_price) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.material_id = 'FG001') * 1.0 / cost.bom_cost, 4) AS price_cost_ratio FROM cost

question: 逾期未发货订单对应工单的完工进度如何？
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.due_date, wo.wo_id, wo.status, wo.planned_qty, wo.completed_qty, ROUND(wo.completed_qty * 1.0 / wo.planned_qty, 4) AS completion_rate FROM sales_order o JOIN work_order wo ON wo.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' AND o.due_date < '2026-07-01' ORDER BY o.due_date, wo.wo_id
